description: This file contains implementation of the EicPresentation module, including functions for initializing presentation context, generating signing key pairs, creating ephemeral keys, handling authentication challenges, validating request messages, managing certificates, setting authentication tokens, and performing cryptographic operations related to Android's identity credential system.

methods.name: eicPresentationInit
methods.description: Initializes the EicPresentation context by decrypting credential keys and setting up internal state based on the credential data and document type.

methods.name: eicPresentationGenerateSigningKeyPair
methods.description: Generates an EC key pair, creates a proof-of-binding CBOR, signs the key, and encrypts the private key for secure storage, also producing a certificate.

methods.name: eicPresentationCreateEphemeralKeyPair
methods.description: Creates an ephemeral EC key pair for session-specific cryptographic operations.

methods.name: eicPresentationCreateAuthChallenge
methods.description: Generates a random challenge value for authentication purposes.

methods.name: eicPresentationValidateRequestMessage
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a request message using the provided session transcript and public key.

methods.name: eicPresentationPushReaderCert
methods.description: Adds a reader's X.509 certificate to the context, extracting and storing its public key for future validation.

methods.name: eicPresentationSetAuthToken
methods.description: Sets an authentication token in the context after validating the challenge and token integrity.

methods.name: eicPresentationValidateAccessControlProfile
methods.description: Validates access control profiles based on provided reader certificate, user authentication, and cryptographic checks, updating access masks accordingly.

methods.name: eicPresentationCalcMacKey
methods.description: Calculates a MAC key using ECDH, HKDF, and session transcript, preparing for message authentication.

methods.name: eicPresentationRetrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Decrypts and retrieves a specific entry value from encrypted content, verifying additional data integrity.

methods.name: eicPresentationFinishRetrieval
methods.description: Finalizes the retrieval process by computing the digest to be used for MAC verification.

methods.name: eicPresentationDeleteCredential
methods.description: Creates a signed proof of credential deletion, optionally including a challenge.

methods.name: eicPresentationProveOwnership
methods.description: Creates a proof-of-ownership signature over credential data and challenge.

methods.name: eicPresentationStartRetrieveEntries
methods.description: Resets internal state to prepare for retrieving multiple entries.

methods.name: eicPresentationStartRetrieveEntryValue
methods.description: Prepares for retrieving a specific entry value, calculating its additional data digest.
